name: FY2027 Commerce, Justice, Science Appropriations Bill
status: Approved by House Appropriations Committee; Senate committee action pending; government operating under a continuing resolution through 12/11/2026
effect: Provides $50M for the Office of Space Commerce (within NOAA), well above the $11M requested, and directs continuation of TraCSS.
alignment_notes: Aligns with Pillar 1: Restores funding for the civil SSA/STC backbone the report says Congress should fund securely and sustainably.
sponsors: House Appropriations Committee Chairman Rep. Tom Cole [R-OK-4]
